regions.name: Lake Malawi
regions.quote: Overall, M. callainos colonizes the northwest coast of Lake Malawi between Kande Island and Ngara, and there is also a population near Maleri Island that has been settled by humans.

regions.name: Ruhuhu River
regions.quote: It occurs around the north of the lake, between Ikombe and the Ruhuhu River in the east, and from Kande Island to Ngara in the west.

regions.name: Kande Island
regions.quote: It occurs around the north of the lake, between Ikombe and the Ruhuhu River in the east, and from Kande Island to Ngara in the west.

regions.name: Chitande Island
regions.quote: There is also a population near Chitande Island, where the males are cobalt blue and the females are white.
